# FreeWorksheetKids.com

## About
FreeWorksheetKids.com is a free educational worksheet platform for children from Kindergarten to Primary Grade 6. All worksheets are free to download with no sign-up required.

## What We Offer
- Free printable worksheets for kids (Kindergarten to Grade 6)
- Worksheets available in color version and coloring page version
- Categories: Kindergarten 1-3, Grade 1-6
- Subjects: Math, Thai Language, Science, Art, English, Social Studies
- Free utility tools for teachers and parents

## Free Tools
- QR Code Generator: https://freeworksheetkids.com/qr-generator.html
- Classroom Timer: https://freeworksheetkids.com/classroom-timer.html

## Languages
- Thai (ภาษาไทย)
- English

## Target Audience
- Teachers (primary and kindergarten level)
- Parents with young children
- Students (ages 3-12)
